description: Political Spend '26: Ad Agencies & Polling — FEC independent expenditures (monthly) + Google Political Ads weekly US Spend_USD + FRED advertising agency PPI / NAICS 5418 revenue + consumer sentiment + Kalshi midterm/close-race charts. Forums separate. AdImpact stays map_only.

series.label: FEC Independent Expenditures (monthly USD)
series.official_name: FEC Schedule E / Independent Expenditures — monthly sum (bulk CSV; txn cap $50M; latest file_num per spe_id+tran_id)
series.notes: Core political-spend pulse for ad agencies / polling. Bulk FEC cycle files; drops junk multi-billion protest filings. Not AdImpact channel mix.

series.label: Google Political Ads — weekly US Spend_USD
series.official_name: Google Political Ads Transparency Report — sum of advertiser weekly Spend_USD (US election ads on Google/YouTube)
series.notes: Free public CSV bundle. Google/YouTube election ads only — not total digital or AdImpact channel mix. Point date = Week_Start_Date.

series.label: PPI: Advertising Agencies
series.official_name: FRED PCU541810541810 — Producer Price Index by Industry: Advertising Agencies
series.notes: Pricing pressure / agency service inflation for NAICS 541810.

series.label: Quarterly revenue: Advertising, PR & related (NAICS 5418)
series.official_name: FRED REV5418TMSA — Total Revenue for 5418: Advertising, Public Relations, and Related Services (SA)
series.notes: Broad agency end-market health (includes PR / related — not political-only).

series.label: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment
series.official_name: FRED UMCSENT — University of Michigan: Consumer Sentiment
series.notes: Macro confidence backdrop — soft proxy for broader ad budgets; political spend is more insulated.

series.label: Kalshi — Democrats win Senate 2026
series.official_name: Kalshi CONTROLS-2026-D — Will Democrats win the U.S. Senate in 2026?
series.notes: Chart-only — midterm balance-of-power proxy for cycle intensity / contestedness. Not in backdrop score.

series.label: Kalshi — Democrats win House 2026
series.official_name: Kalshi CONTROLH-2026-D — Will Democrats win the House in 2026?
series.notes: Chart-only — currently one-sided; still useful for regime shifts. Not in backdrop score.

series.label: Kalshi — count of close 2026 Senate races
series.official_name: Kalshi — count of open 2026 Senate Democratic race markets priced 35–65¢ (toss-up band)
series.notes: Chart-only spend-heat proxy: more toss-up races → more ad/polling demand. Snapshot history appends going forward.

series.label: Kalshi — count of close 2026 House races
series.official_name: Kalshi — count of open 2026 House Democratic race markets priced 35–65¢ (toss-up band)
series.notes: Chart-only. Coverage follows which districts Kalshi lists — not a full Cook PVI universe.
